facts.fact: The IPDCP gave attestations to 32 first data protection correspondents on 24 June 2026 after a three-day training in Adétikopé, as implementation of the 2019 law.
facts.system: Loi n°2019-014 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The IPDCP, headed by Colonel Bédiani Belei, ran the June 2026 correspondent training and presented attestations.
The IPDCP launched its first cohort of correspondents on 24 June 2026 and announced a continuing certification scheme.
